plugin.description:
Poser is a posing and scene tool for FINAL FANTASY XIV's group pose.

- Pose actors bone by bone: overlay handles, a graphical body map, and numeric transforms
- IK on any bone with a parent, plus mirror, link and named bone-visibility presets
- Spawn actors and objects, or click a world handle to bring what is already there into the scene
- Borrow the map's own objects by reference and give them back untouched on release
- Save and restore the whole shot — actors, objects, lights, camera and environment — with load options
- Custom lights, camera control and a free camera; snapping, group pivot and group moves
- Gaze control and one-click expressions
- A pose library with tags, authors and search; import and export poses, and MCDF appearance files
- Time, weather and festival control
- On-screen dialogue panels, chat bubbles and status lines drawn with the game's own UI
- Reference pictures as floating, aspect-locked windows
- Twenty-five rebindable actions with Poser, Brio and Ktisis presets

This is a beta. It is not stable and it is not finished. Poser is derivative of Anamnesis, Ktisis and Brio, and those three are the mature tools.

Poser was coded with the use of artificial intelligence. The plugin says so on first launch and asks you to confirm you have read the notice.

website.readmeExcerpt:
# Poser

Poser is a beta [Dalamud](https://github.com/goatcorp/Dalamud) plugin for
posing actors and building scenes in FINAL FANTASY XIV's group pose mode.

## Features

- Pose actors and bones with overlay handles, a body map, numeric controls,
  multi-selection, gizmos, IK, mirror, flip, reset, stash, undo, and redo.
- Play, loop, speed up, slow down, and scrub animations; set expressions and
  gaze; freeze physics.
- Build scenes with actors, objects, lights, cameras, environment, borrowed
  world objects, and overlays; save and load the whole scene.
- Change models, opacity, tint, and wetness; use supported Penumbra,
  Glamourer, Customize+, and MCDF integrations.
- Keep pose and scene libraries with tags, search, and previews; use autosave,
  reference pictures, and rebindable shortcuts.

See the [release notes](docs/release/CHANGELOG.md) and the
[documentation](docs/).

## Distribution status

No verified repository distribution is published yet. A release archive, its
checksums, SBOM, dependency audit, and package scan are approved together from
the final release commit; a source-tree build alone is not a published release.

## Attribution

Poser acknowledges Anamnesis, Ktisis, and Brio.

| Project | Repository | Maintainers and contributors |
|---|---|---|
| Anamnesis | https://github.com/imchillin/Anamnesis | ergoxiv and chirpxiv, after Yuki, Luminiari, Peebs-miqo and AsgardXIV |
| Ktisis | https://github.com/ktisis-tools/Ktisis | Chirp, Cazzar, Bwuny and contributors |
| Brio | https://github.com/Etheirys/Brio | Minmoose, Asgard and contributors |

## AI assistance

Poser was developed with AI assistance.

## License

Poser is licensed under GPL-3.0-only. See [LICENSE](LICENSE).

See [THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.md](THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.md) for third-party notices.

variant.author: Midona
variant.changelog:
- Added editable Body and Face map presets.
- Added default map presets for each race and gender.
- Added Abdomen to the default Body map and improved spacing around Lumbar and Waist.
- Improved bone-map layouts for creatures.
- Added skeleton highlighting when hovering over bones in a map.
- Added Shift-click bone selection in the skeleton overlay.
- Added a button to load default bone-visibility presets.
- Renamed Show uncovered bones to Toggle other.
- Made active bone-preset indicators easier to see.
- Fixed Actor-anchored IK targets not following parent-bone rotations.
- Fixed inconsistent Rope and Fabric behaviour when changing the bone count.
- Fixed IK targets needing repeated drags to move back from their limits.
- Fixed Two Joint End rotation.
- Added pose-aware gaze for Camera and Point targets.
- Removed duplicate Gaze and Expression controls from the Inspector.
- Added selected-entity undo and redo with Alt-based shortcuts.
- Fixed popped-out group Inspectors clearing unrelated selections.
- Fixed spawned and duplicated actors sometimes using the wrong appearance.
- Fixed actors loading with the wrong appearance in saved scenes.
- Fixed actor names being lost when saving and loading scenes.
- Fixed Viera ear-bone visibility after changing ear shape.
- Fixed pose imports and previews switching to the wrong actor.
- Made the pose import window movable and scrollable.
- Separated pose Import and Export buttons into their own rows.
- Added a folder picker and removal button for library folders.
- Added file sorting by name and date.
- Added optional single-click folder navigation and pose import.
- Added customizable pose and animation shortcuts.
- Made shortcut conflicts easier to identify.
- Improved spacing in shortcut settings.
- Restricted window dragging to title bars.
- Fixed Settings search results flashing while typing.
- Added submenu animations.
- Moved Limits above Target in camera Properties.
- Added indoor brightness controls.
